{{Quote|The guardian beasts called tuk'ata...possess great tactical intelligence and can live for centuries without feeding. I would have died in the Tomb of Din Grrut had I not fed a Sith slave to the tuk'ata.|Extract from [[Sorzus Syn]]'s [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|titular chronicle]], [[6900 BBY]]|<ref name="BoS" />}}
'''Din Grrut''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] who died sometime prior to the arrival of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] in [[6900 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> This Sith was interred in a [[Tomb of Din Grrut|personal tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] that ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] explored in her life. In her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|titular chronicle]], Syn remarked that she would have died in this tomb, if she had not fed a [[Grotthu|Sith slave]] to the [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]].<ref name="BoS" />
